premises.text: Login can be fun and seamless by placing an unlocked phone near the computer instead of typing tokens
premises.evidence_span: All you have to do is just put it close to the computer you log in from. And that's it. You're logged in

premises.text: Inaudible ultrasonic frequencies carry the proximity auth signal between devices
premises.evidence_span: our technology uses ultrasonic frequencies, which are inaudible but perfectly detectable to microphones

premises.text: Session keys encrypted for the phone are delivered only when proximity is confirmed
premises.evidence_span: The key is encrypted for your phone. And the phone will get the key only if it's close to your computer, making sure only you can confirm your session

premises.text: Browser-based setup works across endpoints and mobile devices without data-center hardware
premises.evidence_span: we support all endpoints and all mobile devices, and even not for your data center

premises.text: Location allow/block maps extend the product into IAM for banks and large enterprises
premises.evidence_span: Sleek login can also provide identity and access management like never before

value.text: Uncompromising security with an unbelievable seamless login user experience
value.evidence_span: provides uncompromising security and an unbelievable user experience

identity and access management like never before
